summary: Finalized documentation in docs/resources.md to describe the new global Pi resource management behavior (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR paths, skill editing as Markdown, global extension enable/disable folders) and added corresponding protocol rows for resources.skill.read/write and resources.extension.global. Ran prettier, pnpm check, and git status to verify the docs change and surface the broader set of modified files from the global resource manager work.
decisions: Documented that extension toggles cover auto-discovered top-level .ts/.js files and index.ts/index.js directories, while package-provided Pi extensions remain managed through Pi's package settings.
Documented the selected disk roots for managed resources: ~/.pi/agent and ~/.agents, including PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR.

Added protocol entries resources.skill.read (read editable Markdown from a catalogued skill) and resources.skill.write (validate and atomically save editable skill Markdown), plus resources.extension.global to move a global extension between enabled and disabled folders.
